query_text: Create a ranked bar chart for the top 8 value-chain segments by `top-3 funding concentration`, where concentration is the share of each segment’s disclosed funding captured by its three most-funded companies, using company-to-segment assignment from section-2 page ranges, with values shown as percentages and segments sorted descending by concentration.
selection_rule: all eligible segments with numeric funding; capped at the top 8 if available
reasoning_summary: Assigned segment membership from section-2 boundaries.
Kept only companies with numeric disclosed funding.
Ranked companies within each segment by funding and summed the top three values.
Divided top-three funding by each segment’s total disclosed funding and sorted descending.
open_issues: Only 5 value-chain segments are available after de-duplication, so the chart includes all eligible segments instead of eight.
